pages.rm: Animal Cruelty Complaint in Maharashtra – Animal Writes
pages.desc: Report animal cruelty in Maharashtra: the police e-Complaint, the State Animal Welfare Board in Pune, District SPCAs, the 1976 Act and 1962.
pages.focus: animal cruelty complaint maharashtra,report animal cruelty maharashtra,maharashtra animal welfare board
pages.content:
In Maharashtra every district has a District SPCA, chaired by the District Collector, and the State Animal Welfare Board works from the Animal Husbandry Commissionerate in Pune (Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department, updated 8 Aug 2025). You can also complain to the police online through the state's citizen portal.

Report it to the police in Maharashtra

  • The Maharashtra Police citizen portal has a "Register e-Complaint" service. You need to sign up on the portal first (Maharashtra Police citizen portal, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • For emergencies, call 112.
  • For the laws (PCA Act s.11, BNS s.325), what to write, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see our national guide, How to report animal cruelty and file an FIR.

Maharashtra Animal Welfare Board

  • Maharashtra Animal Welfare Board, Commissionerate of Animal Husbandry, Aundh Road, Opposite Spicer College, Aundh, Pune 411067. Phone: 020-25690248. Email: mahaanimalwelfareboard@gmail.com (Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department, updated 8 Aug 2025).
  • The same page says the Board members' three-year terms have expired and new appointments are proposed (Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department, updated 8 Aug 2025).
  • AWBI lists the Board's order as No. PVA-1014/PK563/PDM-3, dated 4 Jul 2016 (AWBI list of State Animal Welfare Boards, Sep 2022).

District SPCAs in Maharashtra

  • A Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (SPCA) is registered in every district. The District Collector is its ex-officio chairman and the district's Deputy Commissioner of Animal Husbandry is member secretary. The District Superintendent of Police, the Zilla Parishad CEO and the RTO are members (Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department, updated 8 Aug 2025).

Maharashtra laws on animals

  • Maharashtra Animal Preservation Act, 1976 (Act 9 of 1977), in force from 1 Mar 1977 (India Code, checked 25 Oct 2026).

1962 and mobile veterinary units in Maharashtra

  • A central call centre at the Animal Husbandry Commissionerate, Pune runs the toll-free number 1962. Mobile veterinary teams cover 73 talukas in 32 districts (Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department, Chief Minister Animal Health Scheme, updated 13 Aug 2025).
  • 1962 is the toll-free number for doorstep veterinary service from MVUs (PIB, 26 Mar 2025).

faq: How do I report animal cruelty in Maharashtra?

You can report animal cruelty in Maharashtra through "Register e-Complaint" on the Maharashtra Police citizen portal, after signing up. In an emergency, call 112. The District SPCA, chaired by the Collector, is another place to report it.
What is the contact of the Maharashtra Animal Welfare Board?
The Maharashtra Animal Welfare Board is at the Commissionerate of Animal Husbandry, Aundh, Pune 411067. Phone 020-25690248, email mahaanimalwelfareboard@gmail.com.
Is there an SPCA in every district of Maharashtra?
Yes. Maharashtra has a registered SPCA in every district, with the District Collector as ex-officio chairman and the district's Deputy Commissioner of Animal Husbandry as member secretary.

pages.rm: Animal Cruelty Complaint in Telangana – Animal Writes
pages.desc: Report animal cruelty in Telangana: the police online petition, District SPCAs under the Collector, the 1977 cow law and 1962 mobile clinics.
pages.focus: animal cruelty complaint telangana,report animal cruelty telangana,telangana animal welfare board
pages.content:
In Telangana each district has a Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (SPCA), chaired by the District Collector, under G.O.Ms.No.12 of 3 Jun 2017 (Mahabubabad district, updated 19 Jan 2024). You can lodge a petition with the police online, and 1962 reaches the state's mobile veterinary clinics.

Report it to the police in Telangana

  • You can lodge a petition with a police station online through the Telangana Police citizen login (Kamareddy district, Police – Lodge a Petition, updated 25 Jan 2021).
  • The state's services list also shows "Online Complaint Registration" by the Police Department, through the same login (Government of Telangana, state services, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • For emergencies, call 112.
  • For the laws (PCA Act s.11, BNS s.325), what to write, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see our national guide, How to report animal cruelty and file an FIR.

District SPCAs in Telangana

  • The Government of Telangana has instructed every district to form an SPCA chaired by the District Collector, under G.O.Ms.No.12 dated 3 Jun 2017 (Mahabubabad district, updated 19 Jan 2024; Nirmal district, updated 2 Apr 2025).

Telangana Animal Welfare Board

  • AWBI lists the Telangana Animal Welfare Board under G.O.Rt.No.146, dated 2 Dec 2019 (AWBI list of State Animal Welfare Boards, Sep 2022). We found no published contact for the Board; the District SPCA and the district animal husbandry office are the local contacts.

Telangana laws on animals

  • Telangana Prohibition of Cow Slaughter and Animal Preservation Act, 1977 (Act 11 of 1977) (India Code, checked 25 Oct 2026).

1962 and mobile veterinary clinics in Telangana

  • Telangana started 100 Mobile Veterinary Clinics, one per Assembly constituency, with the toll-free call centre 1962, on 15 Sep 2017. The call centre runs round the clock (Mahabubabad district, updated 19 Jan 2024; Nirmal district, updated 2 Apr 2025).
  • 1962 is the toll-free number for doorstep veterinary service from MVUs (PIB, 26 Mar 2025).

faq: How do I report animal cruelty in Telangana?

You can report animal cruelty in Telangana by lodging a petition online through the Telangana Police citizen login, or at the police station. In an emergency, call 112. The District SPCA, chaired by the Collector, can also help.
Does every district in Telangana have an SPCA?
Yes. Telangana instructed every district to form an SPCA chaired by the District Collector, under G.O.Ms.No.12 dated 3 Jun 2017.
What is 1962 in Telangana?
1962 is the toll-free number of Telangana's round-the-clock call centre for its 100 Mobile Veterinary Clinics, one per Assembly constituency, started on 15 Sep 2017.

pages.rm: Animal Cruelty Complaint in Goa – Animal Writes
pages.desc: Report animal cruelty in Goa: the police Register Complaint service, the State Animal Welfare Board in Panaji and the Goa Animal Preservation Act.
pages.focus: animal cruelty complaint goa,report animal cruelty goa,goa animal welfare board
pages.content:
In Goa the police "Register Complaint" service takes a complaint against any person with a valid reason, once you register on the portal (Goa Police citizen portal, modified 9 Sep 2026). Goa's own animal law is the Goa Animal Preservation Act, 1995 (Goa Act 7 of 1996).

Report it to the police in Goa

  • The Goa Police citizen portal's "Register Complaint" service lets you register a complaint against any individual with a valid reason. You need to register on the portal first (Goa Police citizen portal, modified 9 Sep 2026).
  • The portal also lists "E-FIR Registration" and "Report a Crime". It does not say which cases the e-FIR covers (Goa Police citizen portal, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • For emergencies, call 112.
  • For the laws (PCA Act s.11, BNS s.325), what to write, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see our national guide, How to report animal cruelty and file an FIR.

Goa State Animal Welfare Board

  • The Goa State Animal Welfare Board was reconstituted by Notification No. 14-9-AH/AWB/2017-18/6002, with the Animal Husbandry Minister as ex-officio chairperson (Official Gazette, Series II No. 42, 18 Jan 2018).
  • Office: Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, Pashusamvardhan Bhavan, Patto, Panaji (same notification).

Goa laws on animals

  • Goa Animal Preservation Act, 1995 (Goa Act 7 of 1996) (India Code, checked 25 Oct 2026). The Bill as passed by the Assembly on 14 Dec 1995 made all offences under it cognizable, with up to 6 months' jail, a fine of up to Rs 1,000, or both (Goa Legislative Assembly, Bill No. 25 of 1995).
  • The Goa Animal Preservation Rules, 1999 are made under the Act (India Code, checked 25 Oct 2026).

Other help in Goa

  • South Goa has a District SPCA (Government of Goa, notifications and notices, 14 Nov 2022).
  • Find animal welfare organisations, District SPCAs and vets in Goa in our Directory.

faq: How do I report animal cruelty in Goa?

You can report animal cruelty in Goa through "Register Complaint" on the Goa Police citizen portal, after registering, or at a police station. In an emergency, call 112. Our national guide explains what to write.
Where is the Goa State Animal Welfare Board?
The Goa State Animal Welfare Board works from the Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, Pashusamvardhan Bhavan, Patto, Panaji. The Animal Husbandry Minister is its chairperson.
Which state law protects animals in Goa?
The Goa Animal Preservation Act, 1995 (Goa Act 7 of 1996) is Goa's own animal law. The Goa Animal Preservation Rules, 1999 are made under it.

pages.rm: Animal Cruelty Complaint in Chandigarh – Animal Writes
pages.desc: Report animal cruelty in Chandigarh: the police online complaint (not the e-FIR), SPCA Sector 38, the animal husbandry office and the cow law.
pages.focus: animal cruelty complaint chandigarh,report animal cruelty chandigarh,spca chandigarh
pages.content:
In Chandigarh the police e-FIR is only for motor-vehicle theft; for animal cruelty use the police "Complaint Registration" service instead (Chandigarh Police portal, checked 25 Oct 2026). The SPCA in Sector 38 (West) is run by the Chandigarh Administration.

Report it to the police in Chandigarh

  • The Chandigarh Police portal has "Complaint Registration (ICMS)". It asks you to log in and verify your mobile number (Chandigarh Police portal, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • The portal's "E-FIR Registration" is for motor-vehicle theft only (Chandigarh Police portal, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • For emergencies, call 112.
  • For the laws (PCA Act s.11, BNS s.325), what to write, Zero FIR and what to do if the police refuse, see our national guide, How to report animal cruelty and file an FIR.

SPCA Chandigarh

  • SPCA, Sector 38 (West), Chandigarh. The Deputy Commissioner is its President, the Director of Animal Husbandry its Vice President and the Joint Director of Animal Husbandry its Honorary Secretary. The Chandigarh Administration took it over in 2016 (Punjab and Haryana High Court, CWP No. 20158 of 2021, 7 Apr 2022).
  • In that case the High Court put on hold the orders that cut volunteers' visiting hours at SPCA Chandigarh, so animal lovers and volunteers could visit on the earlier schedule until their representations were decided (same order).

Chandigarh animal husbandry department and Board

  • Department of Animal Husbandry and Fisheries, Director, Sector 22, Chandigarh. Phone: 0172-2700092. Email: jdahus-chd@nic.in (Chandigarh Administration, Who's who, checked 25 Oct 2026).
  • AWBI lists a State Animal Welfare Board for Chandigarh, order No. VD/4/10/4472, dated 21 Jul 2010 (AWBI list of State Animal Welfare Boards, Sep 2022).

Chandigarh laws on animals

  • Punjab Prohibition of Cow Slaughter Act, 1955 (Act 15 of 1955), listed by India Code as applying to Chandigarh (India Code, checked 25 Oct 2026).

faq: Can I file an e-FIR for animal cruelty in Chandigarh?

No. The Chandigarh Police e-FIR is only for motor-vehicle theft. For animal cruelty, use "Complaint Registration (ICMS)" on the Chandigarh Police portal, or go to the police station. In an emergency, call 112.
Where is SPCA Chandigarh?
SPCA Chandigarh is in Sector 38 (West). The Chandigarh Administration took it over in 2016; the Deputy Commissioner is its President.
What is the contact of Chandigarh's animal husbandry department?
Chandigarh's Department of Animal Husbandry and Fisheries is in Sector 22. Phone 0172-2700092, email jdahus-chd@nic.in.
